agm(a0: double, g0: double) -> double is

    while Math.abs(a - g) > 1.0e-15 * Math.abs(a) do
        let next_a = (a + g) / 2.0

        g = Math.sqrt(a * g)
        a = next_a
    od

    a

write_line("{agm(1.0, 1.0 / Math.sqrt(2.0))}")
